## Senior Data Engineer — Data Platforms & MLOps

I build data products that turn complex, messy data into reliable, scalable systems. My career started in renewable energy as a physicist and energy engineer, working on wind resource assessment and solar research — over time my focus shifted toward data, first as a data scientist and eventually as a data engineer, and today I enjoy working where software engineering, data engineering and machine learning intersect.

Recent work spans designing data lake architectures from the ground up, shipping production ETL/ELT pipelines, building reusable Python infrastructure adopted across teams, and developing LLM-powered enrichment pipelines that bring structure to unstructured data. I've worked in startups, scale-ups and established companies, including co-founding an energy-tech company and leading technical teams — which taught me that good data solutions need close collaboration with domain experts as much as strong technical skills.

- **Focus:** data platforms, ETL/ELT pipelines, MLOps, and putting generative AI into production
- **Currently:** open to Senior Data Engineer / Data Platform / MLOps roles
- **Experience:** 5+ years in data engineering, 15+ years across data science and renewable energy
- **Stack:** Python, Polars, PySpark, SQL, AWS, dbt, Airflow, Docker, Terraform
- **Languages:** Spanish & Catalan (native), English (professional), French (basic)

### Recent highlights

- **Data lake architecture** — designed a data platform from scratch (S3, Glue, Athena, ECS, Lambda, RDS/PostgreSQL) for a multi-country product dataset spanning Spain, France, Italy and Great Britain, with entity-level historical tracking of change over time.
- **LLM-powered enrichment** — built production pipelines using OpenAI/Anthropic APIs for ingredient translation, operator matching and claim classification, with structured data contracts, provider abstraction, retries and caching.
- **Reusable data infrastructure** — designed internal Python libraries (I/O, connectors, logging) adopted across 8–10+ repos and 10+ teams, with versioning, Sphinx docs and automated releases.
- **Pipeline reliability at scale** — optimized dbt models and Redshift SQL to prevent EMR timeouts, and migrated select PySpark/EMR workloads to Polars in Docker, cutting operational cost while improving debuggability.
- **Orchestration at scale** — built and maintained ~50 Airflow pipelines powering production-critical daily/hourly data workflows.
